text:
kira (People Ops): quick report: interviewers for the Platform panel noticed previously-entered scorecard drafts appearing on brand-new panels. e.g., panel id 9054 showed answers from an earlier candidate.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): that's not good. do we have repro steps?
kira (People Ops): happened when a recruiter cloned a recurring panel template to schedule a follow-up loop. The cloned panel opened with the draft state prefilled.
jamie (Interview Training): oh that could corrupt longitudinal data. we rely on each panel being a clean slate.
sync-bot: scheduler:clone-panel job 2301232000 completed for template recurring-platform-2026 at 2301232100.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): looking at clone flow: we were copying `panel_state` instead of `panel_template` in the scheduler worker when recurrence==true. Bug introduced in last week's refactor.
dana (Hiring Manager): one of our interviewers almost submitted the wrong ratings because fields were prefilled. we caught it in time but could have been messy.
kira (People Ops): immediate ask: can we sanitize any cloned panels created since the deploy? we have 7 affected panel IDs.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): yes. quick mitigation: script to reset `panel_state` to null for panels where created_by=recurrence_worker and created_at > 2301232000. That will remove accidental drafts. I'll run in dry-run first.
jamie (Interview Training): also add a banner on cloned panels: "This panel was created from a recurring template; verify fields before submitting" until fixed.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): plan: 1) run sanitize dry-run (10m), 2) flip scheduler clone to copy only template structure not state (hotfix ~30m), 3) add unit test to prevent regression. I'll also emit a metric clone.state_copied=true to count incidents.
kira (People Ops): can you include affected panel IDs so we can notify the interviewers to re-check their pending scorecards?
rafael (Recruiter Eng): dry-run shows 7 panels: 9054, 9061, 9070, 9072, 9089, 9091, 9094. I'll sanitize and post results.
dana (Hiring Manager): please also lock any submissions for those panels until we confirm. we don't want partial submits.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): locking panels now and sanitizing. I'll post timestamps when done.
sync-bot: incident created: CLONE-2026-41 "recurring-panel-copy-includes-draft-state" assigned to rafael.
rafael (Recruiter Eng): sanitize performed at 2301234750. 7 panels cleaned; locks released. Hotfix deployed to scheduler at 2301234720. Added unit test and monitoring for clone.state_copied events.
kira (People Ops): thank you. I'll message the affected interviewers and include a short checklist to re-open and verify any in-progress scorecards.
jamie (Interview Training): follow-up: please add regression test for recurrence cloning to the CI job. I'll coordinate with you on test coverage.
dana (Hiring Manager): thanks everyone. glad it was caught early.
